html: I revamped much of the original sandbox to be a bit more inside your universe and, generally speaking, a bit more plausible. If you could take a look at it at some point, that would be great. I was thinking it could be a launch-off point for some of the more minor conflicts featured, since the amount of balkanization in Africa and Asia couldn't have been done without the dropping of blood at some point. Thank you.  <ac_metadata title="Arabian-Assyrian War"> </ac_metadata>
